qxb-gs-basic-info v1.0.0

- Initial release for enterprise basic info queries.
- Enables rapid verification of enterprise authenticity, status, and key background info.
- Supports fuzzy name matching to return the best-matching company.
- Returns business info including suspected ultimate controller and shareholding ratio, business scale, tax status, and more.
- Requires configuration of QXBENT_API_TOKEN for API access.
